disease.description: An autosomal recessive congenital enteropathy characterized by intractable secretory diarrhea, resulting in severe dehydration and metabolic acidosis. DIAR12 can be diagnosed based on variable loss of brush-border microvilli, microvillus inclusions, and accumulation of subapical vesicles in villus enterocytes.
